name: Subscription Day
soft_passes: #2 sphere near optical centre but composition crowded right, stars push into top-right safe zone
#3 silhouette reads as refresh/renewal wheel + sparkles; the 4 category arcs are identical in shape, so the breakdown meaning lives only in colour
#4 gross amber-ring form survives 16px, but hairline spokes, small cyan chip, sphere gloss and both stars smear to sub-pixel
#7 coloured ring contrasts strongly (amber lum 212 on bg 54) but the dark sphere hub is dark-on-dark (~1.5:1 grayscale), separated only by its 3D highlight
failures: #6 four saturated hue families in the ring (amber/cyan/purple/green + amber stars) exceed the <=2-family floor; purposeful as a category legend but reads busy
#10 glyph meaning is colour-dependent (the 4 hues are the content) and all effects are baked (speculars, drop-shadows, vignette) rather than layered, so a tinted/mono system render would flatten it

palette.background: ramp #5B5B5B->#363636 (radial vignette on charcoal; recessed dial well #262626)

light_model: single top-left key, soft top-down; baked short drop-shadows under each floating segment and the arrowhead; baked specular highlights on the upper edge of every colour bar and the central sphere; background radial vignette (lighter upper-centre, darker edges/bottom). Effects baked in, not system-applied.
layer_stack: charcoal squircle background with radial vignette
four glossy 3D colour segments (amber/cyan/purple/green donut ring)
amber circular-arrow arrowhead (renewal, front of ring)
devices: renewal-arrow fused with chart-arc (the largest donut segment ends in an arrowhead)
radar/spider stat hub (spokes + 3D sphere) miniaturising the app's in-product chart
category-colour donut ring encoding subscription categories
nocturnal charcoal ground with radial vignette
rhymes_hint: 3D-rendered 'puffy/claymorphic' dark-dashboard emblems (glossy Blender/C4D-style multi-colour ring-chart on near-black, top-lit, baked speculars) common to finance/analytics/subscription trackers
notes: 894x894 webp web render, PRE-MASKED (squircle corners transparent, alpha=0) - not native 1024 full-bleed; unmasked bg layer and true margins unverifiable, mild webp softening; hex +/-3-4 levels. Cross-platform: same emblem reused on macOS/iOS/watchOS (iOS-style 3D render on Mac, not a bespoke layered Icon Composer icon - baked effects fight macOS 26's system light/dark/clear/tinted variants). Strong icon<->app coherence: dominant amber matches cover's pale-yellow brand wash, and the radar hub + coloured segments are faithful miniatures of the actual Statistics screen. Classified big-sur (squircle, front-facing, top-down light, baked micro-shadows, glossy 3D objects) as the closest era; it is decidedly NOT liquid-glass (opaque, baked speculars/shadows, no refraction/translucency).
